content.text:
# Backend exploration summary — Le Temps d'un Délice

Stack: **Express** (`C:\Users\duche\Projects\le-temps-d-un-delice\backend\src\index.js`) + **Prisma/PostgreSQL** (`C:\Users\duche\Projects\le-temps-d-un-delice\backend\prisma\schema.prisma`).

---

## 1. All API routes

| Method | Path | Auth | Roles | Purpose |
|--------|------|------|-------|---------|
| **GET** | `/api/health` | None | — | Health check |
| **POST** | `/api/auth/login` | None | — | Login → JWT |
| **GET** | `/api/auth/me` | `authenticate` | Any logged-in | Current user |
| **GET** | `/api/magasins` | ✓ | ADMIN, PRODUCTION | List magasins |
| **GET** | `/api/magasins/:id` | ✓ | ADMIN, PRODUCTION, MAGASIN* | Magasin detail |
| **POST** | `/api/magasins` | ✓ | **ADMIN** | **Create magasin** |
| **GET** | `/api/produits` | ✓ | Any authenticated | List active produits |
| **POST** | `/api/produits` | ✓ | **ADMIN, PRODUCTION** | **Create produit** (+ stock production row) |
| **GET** | `/api/inventaire?magasinId=` | ✓ | Any* | List inventaire for magasin |
| **PUT** | `/api/inventaire/:produitId` | ✓ | **ADMIN, MAGASIN*** | **Upsert inventaire line** (create or update) |
| **POST** | `/api/inventaire/initialiser` | ✓ | **ADMIN** | **Bulk-create** inventaire rows for all produits |
| **GET** | `/api/commandes` | ✓ | Any* | List commandes (MAGASIN scoped) |
| **GET** | `/api/commandes/:id` | ✓ | Any* | Commande detail |
| **POST** | `/api/commandes` | ✓ | **MAGASIN, ADMIN** | **Create commande** |
| **PATCH** | `/api/commandes/:id/statut` | ✓ | **PRODUCTION, ADMIN** | Update statut (+ side effects on LIVREE) |
| **GET** | `/api/stock/produits` | ✓ | PRODUCTION, ADMIN | Production stock (produits finis) |
| **PUT** | `/api/stock/produits/:produitId` | ✓ | PRODUCTION, ADMIN | Update production stock |
| **GET** | `/api/stock/marchandises` | ✓ | PRODUCTION, ADMIN | Production stock (marchandises) |
| **PUT** | `/api/stock/marchandises/:marchandiseId` | ✓ | PRODUCTION, ADMIN | Update marchandise stock |
| **GET** | `/api/marchandises` | ✓ | PRODUCTION, ADMIN | List marchandises |
| **POST** | `/api/marchandises` | ✓ | **PRODUCTION, ADMIN** | **Create marchandise** (+ stock row) |
| **PUT** | `/api/marchandises/:id` | ✓ | PRODUCTION, ADMIN | Update marchandise |
| **GET** | `/api/dashboard` | ✓ | ADMIN, PRODUCTION | Dashboard stats & alertes |

\* **MAGASIN** users are restricted to their own `magasinId` via inline checks in route handlers.

---

## 2. POST / create endpoints (existing)

| Entity | Endpoint | File | Body fields | Side effects |
|--------|----------|------|-------------|--------------|
| **Produit** | `POST /api/produits` | `backend\src\routes\produits.js` | `nom`, `categorie`, `prix` (required); `description`, `unite` | Creates `StockProductionProduit` row |
| **Marchandise** | `POST /api/marchandises` | `backend\src\routes\marchandises.js` | `nom`, `categorie` (required); `description`, `unite`, `quantite`, `seuilAlerte` | Creates nested `StockProductionMarchandise` |
| **Magasin** | `POST /api/magasins` | `backend\src\routes\magasins.js` | `nom`, `adresse` (required); `telephone` | None |
| **Commande** | `POST /api/commandes` | `backend\src\routes\commandes.js` | `lignes[]` (required); `notes`; `magasinId` (ADMIN only) | Auto-generates `numero`, creates `LigneCommande` rows |
| **Inventaire (bulk)** | `POST /api/inventaire/initialiser` | `backend\src\routes\inventaire.js` | `magasinId` | Upserts 0-qty row per active produit |
| **Inventaire (single)** | `PUT /api/inventaire/:produitId` | `backend\src\routes\inventaire.js` | `magasinId`, `quantite`, `seuilAlerte` | Upsert — **creates if missing** |
| **Auth** | `POST /api/auth/login` | `backend\src\routes\auth.js` | `email`, `password` | Returns JWT |

**Not POST but create-related:** `PUT /api/stock/produits/:produitId` and `PUT /api/stock/marchandises/:marchandiseId` only **update** existing stock rows (created when produit/marchandise is created).

---

## 3. What's missing (by domain)

### Produits
| Status | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| ✅ Create | `POST /api/produits` exists |
| ❌ Update | No `PUT/PATCH /api/produits/:id` |
| ❌ Deactivate | No endpoint to set `actif: false` |
| ❌ Get by ID | No `GET /api/produits/:id` |
| ❌ Auto-inventaire | New produit does **not** create `InventaireMagasin` rows in existing magasins |
| ❌ Frontend UI | `produitsApi.create` exists in `frontend\src\lib\api.ts` but **no page uses it**; no produit management route in `App.tsx` |

### Marchandises
| Status | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| ✅ Create | `POST /api/marchandises` |
| ✅ Update | `PUT /api/marchandises/:id` |
| ✅ Frontend | `MarchandisesPage.tsx` calls create + stock update |
| ❌ Deactivate/delete | No dedicated endpoint |

### Commandes
| Status | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| ✅ Create | `POST /api/commandes` |
| ✅ Status update | `PATCH /api/commandes/:id/statut` |
| ✅ Frontend | `NouvelleCommandePage.tsx` + `CommandesPage.tsx` |
| ❌ Validation | No check that `produitId` exists, quantities > 0, or stock available |
| ❌ Edit/cancel | No endpoint to modify lignes or cancel from MAGASIN |
| ⚠️ Side effect | On `LIVREE`, increments magasin inventaire + decrements production stock (no transaction) |

### Magasins
| Status | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| ✅ Create | `POST /api/magasins` (ADMIN only) |
| ✅ Frontend | `MagasinsPage.tsx` |
| ❌ Update | No `PUT/PATCH /api/magasins/:id` (edit nom, adresse, `actif`) |
| ❌ Auto-inventaire | Creating a magasin does **not** call inventaire init — admin must separately hit `POST /inventaire/initialiser` |
| ❌ User management | No API to create/assign `User` records to magasins |

### Inventaire updates
| Status | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| ✅ Update/create line | `PUT /api/inventaire/:produitId` upserts |
| ✅ Bulk init | `POST /api/inventaire/initialiser` |
| ✅ Frontend (MAGASIN) | `InventairePage.tsx` uses `inventaireApi.update` |
| ❌ Frontend (ADMIN init) | `inventaireApi` has no `initialiser` method — admin can't trigger bulk init from UI |
| ❌ Dedicated POST | No `POST /api/inventaire` (PUT upsert covers it functionally) |
| ❌ Increment API | Only absolute `quantite` set, no `+/- delta` endpoint |
| ❌ PRODUCTION access | PRODUCTION role cannot touch inventaire (by design per README flow) |

### Other missing APIs
- **User CRUD** — users only exist via seed (`backend\prisma\seed.js`)
- **Dashboard for MAGASIN** — dashboard is ADMIN/PRODUCTION only; MAGASIN users see commandes list on home instead

---

## 4. Auth & role restrictions

**Mechanism** (`backend\src\middleware\auth.js`):
- `authenticate` — validates `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`, sets `req.user`
- `authorize(...roles)` — checks `req.user.role`; returns **403** if missing/wrong (not 401)

**JWT payload** (`backend\src\lib\auth.js`): `{ id, email, nom, role, magasinId }`, 8h expiry.

**Router-level patterns:**

| Router file | Global middleware | Notes |
|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| `auth.js` | None (per-route) | `/login` public; `/me` authenticated |
| `produits.js` | `authenticate` | POST adds `authorize('ADMIN','PRODUCTION')` |
| `magasins.js` | `authenticate` | Per-route role checks |
| `commandes.js` | `authenticate` | MAGASIN scoped in handler logic |
| `inventaire.js` | `authenticate` | MAGASIN ownership enforced in handlers |
| `stock.js` | `authenticate` + `authorize('PRODUCTION','ADMIN')` | All routes |
| `marchandises.js` | `authenticate` + `authorize('PRODUCTION','ADMIN')` | All routes |
| `dashboard.js` | `authenticate` + `authorize('ADMIN','PRODUCTION')` | All routes |

**Role matrix (write operations):**

| Action | ADMIN | PRODUCTION | MAGASIN |
|--------|:-----:|:----------:|:-------:|
| Create produit | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Create marchandise | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Create magasin | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Create commande | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ (own magasin) |
| Update commande statut | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Update inventaire | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ (own magasin) |
| Init inventaire bulk | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Update production stock | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |

---

## 5. Prisma models

File: `C:\Users\duche\Projects\le-temps-d-un-delice\backend\prisma\schema.prisma`

```
User ──magasinId?──► Magasin
                        │
         ┌──────────────┼──────────────┐
         ▼              ▼              ▼
InventaireMagasin   Commande      (users)
         │              │
         ▼              ▼
      Produit ◄── LigneCommande
         │
         ▼
StockProductionProduit

Marchandise
         │
         ▼
StockProductionMarchandise
```

| Model | Key fields | Relations |
|-------|-----------|-----------|
| **User** | `email`, `password`, `nom`, `role` (enum), `magasinId?` | → Magasin |
| **Magasin** | `nom`, `adresse`, `telephone?`, `actif` | users, inventaires, commandes |
| **Produit** | `nom`, `description?`, `categorie`, `prix`, `unite`, `actif` | inventaires, lignesCommande, stockProduction |
| **InventaireMagasin** | `magasinId`, `produitId`, `quantite`, `seuilAlerte` | unique `[magasinId, produitId]` |
| **Commande** | `numero` (unique), `magasinId`, `statut` (enum), `notes?` | → Magasin, lignes |
| **LigneCommande** | `commandeId`, `produitId`, `quantite` | unique `[commandeId, produitId]` |
| **Marchandise** | `nom`, `description?`, `categorie`, `unite`, `actif` | → stock (1:1) |
| **StockProductionProduit** | `produitId` (unique), `quantite`, `seuilAlerte` | → Produit |
| **StockProductionMarchandise** | `marchandiseId` (unique), `quantite`, `seuilAlerte` | → Marchandise |

**Enums:** `Role` (ADMIN, MAGASIN, PRODUCTION), `StatutCommande` (EN_ATTENTE → LIVREE, ANNULEE)

---

## 6. Files to modify (if filling gaps)

| Priority | Goal | Files |
|----------|------|-------|
| High | Produit update + UI | `backend\src\routes\produits.js`, new `frontend\src\pages\ProduitsPage.tsx`, `frontend\src\App.tsx`, `frontend\src\lib\api.ts` |
| High | Auto-init inventaire on magasin/produit create | `backend\src\routes\magasins.js`, `backend\src\routes\produits.js` (reuse logic from `inventaire.js`) |
| High | Wire inventaire init in admin UI | `frontend\src\lib\api.ts`, `frontend\src\pages\MagasinsPage.tsx` |
| Medium | Magasin update (edit, deactivate) | `backend\src\routes\magasins.js`, `frontend\src\pages\MagasinsPage.tsx`, `frontend\src\lib\api.ts` |
| Medium | Commande validation | `backend\src\routes\commandes.js` |
| Medium | User creation/assignment | New `backend\src\routes\users.js`, register in `backend\src\index.js` |
| Low | Transaction on LIVREE side effects | `backend\src\routes\commandes.js` |
| Low | Marchandise deactivate | `backend\src\routes\marchandises.js` |

---

## Bottom line

**Create endpoints already exist** for all five domains you asked about:
- **Produits, marchandises, magasins, commandes** → dedicated `POST`
- **Inventaire** → `PUT` upsert (single line) + `POST /initialiser` (bulk)

The real gaps are **workflow completeness** (no auto-inventaire on new magasin/produit), **missing update endpoints** (especially produits & magasins), **no user API**, and **frontend coverage** (produit creation UI absent; admin inventaire init not exposed). Switch to Agent mode if you want these implemented.
